acceptanceCriteria: A change whose intent specs together carry more than 256 requirements can still bind and seal without dropping an intent spec, or the refusal names a supported way to narrow a scope.
The too-many-obligations refusal reports the per-scope counts and the bound.
body: Observed 2026-10-09 binding batch R (beamfall/corvint#710) at base 1120e565 with corvint from origin/main: four intent specs (agent-harness-integration 49, corvint-tasks-agent-leases 195, pending-unpause-recovery 5, go-only-cutover 10) total 259 obligations, and dogfood finish refuses ocm-aggregate too-many-obligations (internal/dogfoodocm/aggregate.go maxObligations=256). There is no section selector in .corvint/change.ocm-intents, so the only workaround was to drop go-only-cutover from the OCM scopes and cite its hunks without an obligation map, which weakens evidence. The leases spec alone is 195 requirements and keeps growing. Expected: a supported scope narrowing (per-section selector) or a bound that scales with the spec set. Actual: hard refusal with only the bare code.
